h1.en: Just Lost Your Job in North Carolina? Here Are Your Health Insurance Options for 2026
h1.es: Acaba de Perder Su Trabajo en Carolina del Norte? Aqui Estan Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico para 2026

subhero.en: North Carolina workers have 60 days from coverage loss to enroll in a new plan. NC Medicaid expanded in December 2023, adding a powerful free option most newly unemployed residents now qualify for.
subhero.es: Los trabajadores de Carolina del Norte tienen 60 dias desde la perdida de cobertura para inscribirse en un nuevo plan. NC Medicaid se expandio en diciembre de 2023, agregando una opcion gratuita poderosa para la que ahora califican la mayoria de residentes recien desempleados.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your North Carolina coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura en Carolina del Norte

body.en: Your 60-day Special Enrollment Period starts the day after your job-based coverage ends. For example, if your coverage ends July 31, 2026, your SEP window runs August 1 through September 29, 2026. Miss that window without another qualifying event and you must wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026 for January 2027 coverage.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias comienza el dia siguiente al fin de su cobertura del trabajo. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura termina el 31 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre del 1 de agosto al 29 de septiembre de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana sin otro evento calificador, debe esperar hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA en noviembre de 2026 para cobertura de enero de 2027.

quickAnswer.en: Losing a job in North Carolina triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov. Three primary paths open immediately: (1) NC Medicaid, which is free year-round and now covers adults up to 138% FPL (about $22,025 single or $45,540 for a family of 4 in 2026) thanks to NC's December 2023 expansion; (2) ACA Marketplace plans with premium tax credits, averaging about $97 per month after subsidies for 2026 NC enrollees who qualify; (3) COBRA or NC state continuation, which preserve your old plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $2,000 per month. Children may also qualify for NC Health Choice (CHIP) at incomes up to 211% FPL regardless of your own eligibility.
quickAnswer.es: Perder un trabajo en Carolina del Norte activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. Tres rutas principales se abren de inmediato: (1) NC Medicaid, que es gratuito todo el ano y ahora cubre adultos hasta el 138% FPL (aproximadamente $22,025 individual o $45,540 para familia de 4 en 2026) gracias a la expansion de NC en diciembre de 2023; (2) planes del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales de prima, promediando aproximadamente $97 por mes despues de subsidios para inscritos de NC en 2026 que califican; (3) COBRA o continuacion estatal de NC, que preservan su plan anterior al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $2,000 por mes. Los ninos tambien pueden calificar para NC Health Choice (CHIP) con ingresos hasta 211% FPL independientemente de su propia elegibilidad.

introParagraphs.en: Losing a job in North Carolina is stressful enough. Losing health insurance at the same time creates an immediate clock: the 60-day Marketplace Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Most North Carolinians in this situation have more options than they realize, and most of those options cost far less than COBRA. North Carolina expanded Medicaid on December 1, 2023, which fundamentally changed the landscape for newly unemployed residents. Before expansion, many laid-off workers in NC fell into a coverage gap between too much income for older Medicaid and too little for Marketplace subsidies. That gap is largely closed. In 2026, a single adult earning under $22,025 qualifies for NC Medicaid year-round at no cost. A family of four qualifies up to $45,540. North Carolina uses the federally run marketplace at healthcare.gov, so applying for ACA coverage and checking Medicaid eligibility can happen in one place. The 2026 ACA Marketplace also carries a significantly different subsidy structure from 2024 and 2025: the enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired on January 1, 2026. The subsidy cliff at 400% FPL is back for 2026. That means projecting your income carefully this year matters more than it did last year, because crossing the 400% FPL line ($63,840 single, $132,000 family of 4) eliminates subsidies entirely rather than capping them.
introParagraphs.es: Perder un trabajo en Carolina del Norte es suficientemente estresante. Perder el seguro de salud al mismo tiempo crea un reloj inmediato: el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) del Mercado de 60 dias. La mayoria de los residentes de Carolina del Norte en esta situacion tienen mas opciones de las que se dan cuenta, y la mayoria de esas opciones cuestan mucho menos que COBRA. Carolina del Norte expandio Medicaid el 1 de diciembre de 2023, lo que cambio fundamentalmente el panorama para los residentes recien desempleados. Antes de la expansion, muchos trabajadores despedidos en NC caian en una brecha de cobertura entre demasiado ingreso para el Medicaid antiguo y muy poco para los subsidios del Mercado. Esa brecha esta en gran parte cerrada. En 2026, un adulto soltero que gana menos de $22,025 califica para NC Medicaid todo el ano sin costo. Una familia de cuatro califica hasta $45,540. Carolina del Norte usa el mercado federal en healthcare.gov, por lo que solicitar cobertura ACA y verificar elegibilidad de Medicaid puede ocurrir en un solo lugar.

introParagraphs.en: North Carolina's marketplace enrolled roughly 700,000 residents for 2026 coverage, with 87% receiving premium tax credits averaging $660 per month in gross subsidy. After those credits, the average subsidized enrollee in NC paid around $97 per month. Six insurance carriers offered plans for 2026 in NC: Blue Cross NC, Oscar Health, AmeriHealth Caritas, Medcost Benefit Services, United American Insurance, and Wellpoint. Premium sticker prices rose an average of 28.6% in 2026 following the enhanced subsidy expiration, but subsidized costs did not rise at the same rate for those whose income qualifies for large tax credits. For workers with a spouse still employed, joining the spouse's employer plan is often the cheapest path and carries a 30-day window from the qualifying event. Children who do not qualify for Medicaid directly may qualify for NC Health Choice, which is North Carolina's CHIP program, with year-round enrollment at incomes up to 211% FPL. The steps below walk through how to calculate your options, apply in the right order, and avoid the most costly mistakes North Carolinians make after a job loss.
introParagraphs.es: El mercado de Carolina del Norte inscribio aproximadamente 700,000 residentes para cobertura 2026, con el 87% recibiendo creditos fiscales de prima promediando $660 por mes en subsidio bruto. Despues de esos creditos, el inscrito subsidiado promedio en NC pago alrededor de $97 por mes. Seis aseguradoras ofrecieron planes para 2026 en NC. Para trabajadores con un conyuge todavia empleado, unirse al plan del empleador del conyuge es a menudo la ruta mas economica y tiene una ventana de 30 dias desde el evento calificador. Los ninos que no califican directamente para Medicaid pueden calificar para NC Health Choice, que es el programa CHIP de Carolina del Norte, con inscripcion todo el ano con ingresos hasta 211% FPL. Los pasos a continuacion explican como calcular sus opciones, aplicar en el orden correcto y evitar los errores mas costosos que cometen los residentes de Carolina del Norte despues de una perdida de empleo.

name.en: Calculate your projected 2026 household income for the rest of the year
name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado del hogar para el resto del 2026

text.en: Use what you will actually earn going forward, not your old salary. Include unemployment benefits (they count as MAGI income for ACA subsidy calculations), any part-time or freelance income you anticipate, and any severance paid out over time. For 2026, compare your projected annual income to 138% FPL for NC Medicaid eligibility ($22,025 single / $45,540 family of 4) and to 400% FPL for the ACA subsidy ceiling ($63,840 single / $132,000 family of 4).
text.es: Use lo que realmente ganara en adelante, no su salario anterior. Incluya los beneficios por desempleo (cuentan como ingreso MAGI para calculos de subsidios ACA), cualquier ingreso parcial o independiente que anticipe, y cualquier liquidacion pagada en el tiempo. Para 2026, compare su ingreso anual proyectado con el 138% FPL para elegibilidad de NC Medicaid ($22,025 individual / $45,540 familia de 4) y con el 400% FPL para el techo de subsidio ACA ($63,840 individual / $132,000 familia de 4).

name.en: Check NC Medicaid eligibility first at healthcare.gov or epass.nc.gov
name.es: Verifique primero la elegibilidad de NC Medicaid en healthcare.gov o epass.nc.gov

text.en: NC Medicaid is year-round with no enrollment deadline. Apply at healthcare.gov or through the NC ePASS portal at epass.nc.gov. If your projected 2026 income is under 138% FPL, NC Medicaid covers you at no premium and minimal cost sharing. Medicaid coverage can start the month you apply or even retroactively in some circumstances. Call NC DHHS at 1-888-245-0179 if you need help applying.
text.es: NC Medicaid es todo el ano sin fecha limite de inscripcion. Solicite en healthcare.gov o a traves del portal NC ePASS en epass.nc.gov. Si su ingreso proyectado 2026 es inferior al 138% FPL, NC Medicaid lo cubre sin prima y con costo minimo compartido. La cobertura de Medicaid puede comenzar el mes en que solicite o incluso retroactivamente en algunas circunstancias. Llame a NC DHHS al 1-888-245-0179 si necesita ayuda para solicitar.

name.en: If income exceeds 138% FPL, compare ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov within the 60-day SEP
name.es: Si el ingreso supera el 138% FPL, compare planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov dentro del SEP de 60 dias

text.en: Log in to healthcare.gov and select the Special Enrollment Period for loss of coverage. Enter your projected income and North Carolina ZIP code to see 2026 plans with premium tax credits applied. Most North Carolinians who qualify for subsidies can find Silver plans under $150 per month. Six carriers offered plans in NC for 2026: Blue Cross NC, Oscar Health, AmeriHealth Caritas, Medcost Benefit Services, United American Insurance, and Wellpoint. Compare provider networks carefully before selecting, since not every plan includes your existing doctors.
text.es: Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov y seleccione el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por perdida de cobertura. Ingrese su ingreso proyectado y su codigo postal de Carolina del Norte para ver los planes 2026 con creditos fiscales de prima aplicados. La mayoria de residentes de NC que califican para subsidios pueden encontrar planes Silver por menos de $150 por mes. Seis aseguradoras ofrecieron planes en NC para 2026: Blue Cross NC, Oscar Health, AmeriHealth Caritas, Medcost Benefit Services, United American Insurance, y Wellpoint.

name.en: Check if a spouse's employer plan is available, and note the 30-day window
name.es: Verifique si hay disponible un plan del empleador del conyuge, y tenga en cuenta la ventana de 30 dias

text.en: Losing job-based coverage is a qualifying life event under your spouse's employer plan. Most employers give you 30 days to add a newly eligible dependent after a qualifying event. Call your spouse's HR department on the day your coverage ends to start the process. Joining a spouse's employer plan is often cheaper than any Marketplace option, especially for lower-premium employer plans that cover families.
text.es: Perder la cobertura del trabajo es un evento de vida calificador bajo el plan del empleador de su conyuge. La mayoria de los empleadores le dan 30 dias para agregar un dependiente recien elegible despues de un evento calificador. Llame al departamento de Recursos Humanos de su conyuge el dia en que termine su cobertura para iniciar el proceso. Unirse al plan del empleador de un conyuge es a menudo mas barato que cualquier opcion del Mercado, especialmente para planes de empleador con primas mas bajas que cubren familias.

name.en: Enroll children in NC Health Choice (CHIP) if they do not qualify for Medicaid
name.es: Inscribir a los ninos en NC Health Choice (CHIP) si no califican para Medicaid

text.en: NC Health Choice is North Carolina's CHIP program. Children under age 19 qualify if family income is between 100% and 211% FPL and they do not qualify for Medicaid directly. NC Health Choice enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Apply at healthcare.gov or through NC ePASS. Premiums are low or free depending on income, with comprehensive coverage including dental and vision.
text.es: NC Health Choice es el programa CHIP de Carolina del Norte. Los ninos menores de 19 anos califican si el ingreso familiar esta entre el 100% y el 211% FPL y no califican directamente para Medicaid. La inscripcion en NC Health Choice es todo el ano sin fecha limite. Solicite en healthcare.gov o a traves de NC ePASS. Las primas son bajas o gratuitas dependiendo del ingreso, con cobertura integral que incluye dental y vision.

name.en: Evaluate COBRA or NC state continuation only as a last resort
name.es: Evaluar COBRA o la continuacion estatal de NC solo como ultimo recurso

text.en: Federal COBRA applies if your former employer had 20 or more employees. NC mini-COBRA (state continuation) applies to employers with fewer than 20 employees. Both charge 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $2,000 per month for individual coverage and $1,200 to $2,800 for families. COBRA is rarely cheaper than subsidized Marketplace plans after a job loss, but may be worth it if you have ongoing treatment with a specialist not in any NC Marketplace network or if you are close to meeting a high deductible for 2026.
text.es: COBRA federal aplica si su ex-empleador tenia 20 o mas empleados. NC mini-COBRA (continuacion estatal) aplica a empleadores con menos de 20 empleados. Ambas cobran el 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $2,000 por mes para cobertura individual y $1,200 a $2,800 para familias. COBRA rara vez es mas barato que los planes del Mercado subsidiados despues de una perdida de empleo, pero puede valer la pena si tiene tratamiento continuo con un especialista no incluido en ninguna red del Mercado de NC.

name.en: Submit your application and keep your 1095-A for tax filing
name.es: Envie su solicitud y guarde su 1095-A para la declaracion de impuestos

text.en: After enrolling in a Marketplace plan through healthcare.gov, you will receive Form 1095-A in early 2027. Use it to complete IRS Form 8962 to reconcile your premium tax credits on your 2026 tax return. If your actual income was higher than projected, you may owe back some subsidies. If lower, you may receive additional credits. For NC Medicaid or NC Health Choice, no 1095-A is issued, but keep your enrollment confirmation for records.
text.es: Despues de inscribirse en un plan del Mercado a traves de healthcare.gov, recibira el Formulario 1095-A a principios de 2027. Uselo para completar el Formulario IRS 8962 para conciliar sus creditos fiscales de prima en su declaracion de impuestos 2026. Si su ingreso real fue mayor que el proyectado, puede deber algunos subsidios de regreso. Si fue menor, puede recibir creditos adicionales. Para NC Medicaid o NC Health Choice, no se emite un 1095-A, pero guarde su confirmacion de inscripcion para sus registros.

footnote.en: NC Medicaid is administered by the NC Department of Health and Human Services (NC DHHS) through managed care organizations (MCOs). ACA Marketplace costs reflect 2026 premium tax credits for eligible North Carolina enrollees; actual costs depend on projected household income and ZIP code. COBRA costs represent the 2026 range for typical employer group plans in NC.
footnote.es: NC Medicaid es administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de NC (NC DHHS) a traves de organizaciones de cuidado manejado (MCOs). Los costos del Mercado ACA reflejan los creditos fiscales de prima 2026 para inscritos elegibles de Carolina del Norte; los costos reales dependen del ingreso del hogar proyectado y el codigo postal. Los costos de COBRA representan el rango 2026 para planes grupales tipicos de empleadores en NC.

intro.en: The most expensive mistakes North Carolinians make after losing job-based coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen los residentes de Carolina del Norte despues de perder cobertura del trabajo en 2026:

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without comparing NC Medicaid and Marketplace options first. After NC Medicaid expanded in December 2023, many formerly uninsured NC workers now qualify for free coverage they did not have access to while employed.
items.es: Optar por COBRA sin comparar primero las opciones de NC Medicaid y del Mercado. Tras la expansion de NC Medicaid en diciembre de 2023, muchos trabajadores de NC anteriormente no asegurados ahora califican para cobertura gratuita a la que no tenian acceso mientras estaban empleados.

items.en: Reporting your old North Carolina salary as your projected income. The Marketplace calculates subsidies on what you will actually earn the rest of the year. A worker laid off June 12, 2026, who earned $70,000 through that date but expects $0 income going forward should project roughly $40,000 for the rest of 2026, not $70,000.
items.es: Reportar su salario antiguo de Carolina del Norte como su ingreso proyectado. El Mercado calcula los subsidios sobre lo que realmente ganara el resto del ano. Un trabajador despedido el 12 de junio de 2026 que gano $70,000 hasta esa fecha pero espera $0 de ingreso en adelante debe proyectar aproximadamente $40,000 para el resto de 2026, no $70,000.

items.en: Forgetting that North Carolina unemployment benefits count as income for ACA subsidy calculations under MAGI rules. Include unemployment compensation in your projected annual income when applying at healthcare.gov.
items.es: Olvidar que los beneficios de desempleo de Carolina del Norte cuentan como ingreso para los calculos de subsidios ACA bajo las reglas MAGI. Incluya la compensacion por desempleo en su ingreso anual proyectado al solicitar en healthcare.gov.

items.en: Missing the 60-day SEP window entirely. Without another qualifying life event, you are locked out of ACA Marketplace plans until November 2026 Open Enrollment, meaning January 2027 coverage at the earliest.
items.es: Perder completamente la ventana SEP de 60 dias. Sin otro evento de vida calificador, queda excluido de los planes del Mercado ACA hasta la Inscripcion Abierta de noviembre de 2026, lo que significa cobertura de enero de 2027 en el mejor de los casos.

items.en: Not enrolling children in NC Health Choice when the family does not qualify for NC Medicaid. NC Health Choice (CHIP) is year-round for children up to 211% FPL and runs independently of the parent's coverage status.
items.es: No inscribir a los ninos en NC Health Choice cuando la familia no califica para NC Medicaid. NC Health Choice (CHIP) esta disponible todo el ano para ninos hasta el 211% FPL y funciona independientemente del estado de cobertura del padre.

items.en: Assuming the 2024 or 2025 enhanced subsidy rules still apply in 2026. The enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff is back for 2026 NC enrollees.
items.es: Asumir que las reglas de subsidio mejorado de 2024 o 2025 todavia aplican en 2026. Los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026. El acantilado de subsidio del 400% FPL esta de vuelta para los inscritos de NC en 2026.

en: Proof of North Carolina job-based coverage loss: employer termination letter, COBRA election notice, or written confirmation of last day of coverage
Social Security numbers for all household members applying for coverage
North Carolina home address and ZIP code (determines which NC Marketplace plans are available)
Projected 2026 household income: most recent pay stubs, unemployment award letter, and any other income documentation
Birth certificates or other age verification for dependents (required for NC Health Choice / CHIP applications)
Immigration documents if any household member is a non-citizen (applies to ACA Marketplace and NC Medicaid lawful presence rules)
Prior year tax return (Form 1040) to cross-reference income if requested by healthcare.gov during SEP verification
COBRA or state continuation election paperwork if you are considering that route (needed to document you have or declined prior coverage)
es: Prueba de perdida de cobertura del trabajo en Carolina del Norte: carta de despido del empleador, aviso de eleccion de COBRA, o confirmacion escrita del ultimo dia de cobertura
Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura
Direccion de hogar y codigo postal de Carolina del Norte (determina que planes del Mercado de NC estan disponibles)
Ingreso del hogar proyectado para 2026: talones de pago mas recientes, carta de adjudicacion de desempleo, y cualquier otra documentacion de ingreso
Certificados de nacimiento u otra verificacion de edad para dependientes (requerido para solicitudes de NC Health Choice / CHIP)
Documentos de inmigracion si algun miembro del hogar es no ciudadano (aplica a las reglas de presencia legal del Mercado ACA y NC Medicaid)
Declaracion de impuestos del ano anterior (Formulario 1040) para hacer referencia cruzada de ingresos si lo solicita healthcare.gov durante la verificacion SEP
Formularios de eleccion de COBRA o continuacion estatal si esta considerando esa ruta (necesario para documentar que tiene o declino cobertura previa)

en: Missing the 60-day SEP window: applying after Day 60 from the North Carolina coverage loss date, without another qualifying event
Insufficient documentation of the qualifying event: no termination letter or COBRA notice to prove the job-based coverage loss
Reporting prior-year or at-termination salary instead of projected forward income, which inflates the income estimate and reduces subsidy eligibility

Failing to apply for NC Medicaid before Marketplace: if your income qualifies for Medicaid, the Marketplace will redirect you there, so checking Medicaid first at healthcare.gov or epass.nc.gov saves time
Immigration status errors: non-citizens must meet lawful presence requirements for ACA Marketplace plans; emergency Medicaid rules differ and must be applied separately through NC DHHS
es: Perder la ventana SEP de 60 dias: solicitar despues del Dia 60 desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura en Carolina del Norte, sin otro evento calificador
Documentacion insuficiente del evento calificador: no hay carta de despido ni aviso de COBRA para probar la perdida de cobertura del trabajo
Reportar el salario del ano anterior o al momento del despido en lugar del ingreso proyectado hacia adelante, lo que infla la estimacion de ingresos y reduce la elegibilidad para subsidios
No solicitar NC Medicaid antes del Mercado: si su ingreso califica para Medicaid, el Mercado lo redirigira alli, por lo que verificar Medicaid primero en healthcare.gov o epass.nc.gov ahorra tiempo

Errores de estatus migratorio: los no ciudadanos deben cumplir los requisitos de presencia legal para los planes del Mercado ACA; las reglas de Medicaid de emergencia difieren y deben aplicarse por separado a traves de NC DHHS

heading.en: COBRA vs NC Medicaid vs ACA Marketplace: Which Should North Carolina Workers Choose?
heading.es: COBRA vs NC Medicaid vs Mercado ACA: Que Deben Elegir los Trabajadores de Carolina del Norte?

body.en: Three primary paths open the moment a North Carolina worker loses job-based coverage in 2026. NC Medicaid is the most underutilized: free, year-round, no enrollment deadline, and now available to any adult under 138% FPL thanks to NC's December 2023 expansion. Many workers do not realize they qualify because their employer income was too high while employed, but projected post-layoff income often falls below the threshold. ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov come second, available during the 60-day Special Enrollment Period with premium tax credits that averaged $660 per month in gross subsidy for NC enrollees in 2026. After those credits, most subsidized NC enrollees paid under $200 per month for a Silver plan, though the 2026 subsidy cliff at 400% FPL applies for the first time since 2020. COBRA preserves your exact prior plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $2,000 per month for individuals. COBRA's case in 2026 is narrow: ongoing treatment with a specialist not in any NC Marketplace network, or a calendar-year deductible already substantially met. The decision matrix for North Carolina workers: check NC Medicaid eligibility first at epass.nc.gov or healthcare.gov (free, year-round, best outcome if income qualifies); then compare a spouse's employer plan at 30-day deadline (often cheapest if employer subsidizes the family premium); then evaluate Marketplace plans during the 60-day SEP window (most common path for those with income above Medicaid threshold); only choose COBRA if continuity of a specific provider or a met deductible makes it worth the cost.
body.es: Tres rutas principales se abren en el momento en que un trabajador de Carolina del Norte pierde la cobertura del trabajo en 2026. NC Medicaid es la mas subutilizada: gratuita, todo el ano, sin fecha limite de inscripcion, y ahora disponible para cualquier adulto bajo el 138% FPL gracias a la expansion de NC de diciembre de 2023. Muchos trabajadores no se dan cuenta de que califican porque su ingreso de empleador era demasiado alto mientras estaban empleados, pero el ingreso proyectado despues del despido a menudo cae por debajo del umbral. Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov vienen en segundo lugar, disponibles durante el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias con creditos fiscales de prima que promediaron $660 por mes en subsidio bruto para los inscritos de NC en 2026. Despues de esos creditos, la mayoria de los inscritos subsidiados de NC pagaron menos de $200 por mes por un plan Silver. COBRA preserva su plan anterior exacto al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $2,000 por mes para individuos.

heading.en: NC Medicaid After Job Loss in 2026: Who Qualifies and How to Apply
heading.es: NC Medicaid Despues de Perder el Trabajo en 2026: Quien Califica y Como Solicitar

paragraphs.en: NC Medicaid expansion, launched December 1, 2023, extended Medicaid eligibility to adults ages 19-64 earning up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. For 2026, that means a single adult earning under $22,025 per year qualifies, as does a family of four earning under $45,540. North Carolina applies the standard MAGI-based income counting rules: unemployment compensation counts, severance counts, part-time and self-employment income counts, but gifts and inheritances do not count as MAGI income. Workers who earned above the threshold while employed frequently find they qualify immediately after losing a job, because their forward-looking income projection drops sharply. North Carolina Medicaid enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Apply at healthcare.gov (which checks Medicaid eligibility automatically) or directly through the NC ePASS portal at epass.nc.gov. NC DHHS customer service is reachable at 1-888-245-0179. Approved NC Medicaid enrollees receive coverage through one of several Managed Care Organizations (MCOs) that contract with the state, including Carolina Complete Health, Healthy Blue, AmeriHealth Caritas, WellCare of North Carolina, and UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of NC.
paragraphs.es: La expansion de NC Medicaid, lanzada el 1 de diciembre de 2023, extendio la elegibilidad de Medicaid a adultos de 19 a 64 anos que ganan hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Para 2026, eso significa que un adulto soltero que gana menos de $22,025 por ano califica, al igual que una familia de cuatro que gana menos de $45,540. Carolina del Norte aplica las reglas estandar de conteo de ingresos basadas en MAGI: la compensacion por desempleo cuenta, la liquidacion cuenta, los ingresos parciales y de trabajo independiente cuentan, pero los regalos y herencias no cuentan como ingreso MAGI. Los trabajadores que ganaban por encima del umbral mientras estaban empleados frecuentemente descubren que califican de inmediato despues de perder un trabajo, porque su proyeccion de ingreso hacia adelante cae drasticamente.

paragraphs.en: NC Medicaid in 2026 provides comprehensive coverage including primary care, specialist visits, hospitalization, mental health and substance use disorder services, prescription drugs, and preventive care at no premium. Most enrollees pay no copays for primary care and low or no copays for specialist visits depending on income. Children covered through NC Medicaid or NC Health Choice (CHIP) maintain continuous 12-month eligibility once enrolled, meaning their coverage does not terminate even if household income fluctuates during the year. Dental and vision are included for children through both NC Medicaid and NC Health Choice. Adults in NC Medicaid have limited dental coverage for emergency and preventive services. If your income later rises above 138% FPL, you have a 60-day Special Enrollment Period to transition to a Marketplace plan when Medicaid terminates, which means your coverage will not lapse between programs if you act promptly.
paragraphs.es: NC Medicaid en 2026 proporciona cobertura integral que incluye atencion primaria, visitas a especialistas, hospitalizacion, servicios de salud mental y trastornos por uso de sustancias, medicamentos recetados y atencion preventiva sin prima. La mayoria de los inscritos no pagan copagos por atencion primaria y copagos bajos o nulos por visitas a especialistas dependiendo del ingreso. Los ninos cubiertos a traves de NC Medicaid o NC Health Choice (CHIP) mantienen elegibilidad continua de 12 meses una vez inscritos, lo que significa que su cobertura no termina aunque el ingreso del hogar fluctue durante el ano.

heading.en: 2026 ACA Marketplace Plans in North Carolina: Costs, Carriers, and the SEP Window
heading.es: Planes del Mercado ACA en Carolina del Norte 2026: Costos, Aseguradoras y la Ventana SEP

paragraphs.en: North Carolina uses the federally facilitated Marketplace at healthcare.gov. During the 2026 Open Enrollment (November 1, 2025 to January 15, 2026), roughly 700,000 NC residents enrolled in Marketplace coverage, with 87% receiving premium tax credits. The average subsidy was $660 per month in gross premium assistance, bringing the average after-subsidy cost to approximately $97 per month for eligible enrollees. Six carriers offered plans in North Carolina for 2026: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina, Oscar Health, AmeriHealth Caritas of North Carolina, Medcost Benefit Services, United American Insurance Company, and Wellpoint (formerly Anthem). Not all carriers are available in every NC county, so your options depend on your ZIP code. Plans are available in four metal tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum) plus Catastrophic for those under 30 or with a hardship exemption. Silver plans are generally the best value for those with income between 138% and 250% FPL because Cost-Sharing Reduction (CSR) subsidies apply only to Silver tier plans and can significantly reduce your deductible and out-of-pocket maximum.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Norte usa el Mercado federal en healthcare.gov. Durante la Inscripcion Abierta 2026 (1 de noviembre de 2025 al 15 de enero de 2026), aproximadamente 700,000 residentes de NC se inscribieron en cobertura del Mercado, con el 87% recibiendo creditos fiscales de prima. El subsidio promedio fue de $660 por mes en asistencia de prima bruta, llevando el costo promedio despues del subsidio a aproximadamente $97 por mes para los inscritos elegibles. Seis aseguradoras ofrecieron planes en Carolina del Norte para 2026: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina, Oscar Health, AmeriHealth Caritas of North Carolina, Medcost Benefit Services, United American Insurance Company, y Wellpoint (anteriormente Anthem).

paragraphs.en: Marketplace Special Enrollment Periods for job loss work as follows in North Carolina: your SEP begins the day after your job-based coverage ends and runs for 60 days. Coverage under a Marketplace plan typically starts the first day of the month after your enrollment date. If you enroll before the 15th of a month, coverage begins on the first of the following month. North Carolina is a federally facilitated state, meaning there is no state-based enrollment portal separate from healthcare.gov. The qualifying life event code for a job-based coverage loss SEP is Loss of Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC). When applying through healthcare.gov, select this option and provide the date your employer coverage ended. You may be asked to submit documentation (typically a termination of coverage letter or COBRA election notice) within 30 days of enrollment to verify the qualifying event. Premium tax credits in 2026 are calculated on a sliding scale between 138% FPL (where Medicaid ends) and 400% FPL (where the subsidy cliff begins). Income above 400% FPL ($63,840 single, $132,000 family of 4) receives no premium tax credit in 2026, unlike 2021 through 2025 when enhanced credits applied.
paragraphs.es: Los Periodos de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado para perdida de trabajo funcionan de la siguiente manera en Carolina del Norte: su SEP comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura del trabajo y corre por 60 dias. La cobertura bajo un plan del Mercado tipicamente comienza el primer dia del mes despues de su fecha de inscripcion. Si se inscribe antes del dia 15 de un mes, la cobertura comienza el primero del mes siguiente. Carolina del Norte es un estado de mercado federal, lo que significa que no hay un portal de inscripcion estatal separado de healthcare.gov.

heading.en: COBRA and NC State Continuation Coverage: When It Makes Sense in 2026
heading.es: COBRA y Continuacion de Cobertura Estatal de NC: Cuando Tiene Sentido en 2026

paragraphs.en: Federal COBRA applies to North Carolina employers with 20 or more employees. NC state continuation (sometimes called NC mini-COBRA) applies to group health plans from employers with fewer than 20 employees under NC General Statutes. Both let you continue your exact prior coverage at 102% of the full premium (employer share plus employee share plus a 2% administrative fee). For a typical individual plan in NC, COBRA costs range from $400 to $900 per month. Family plans typically run $1,200 to $2,800 per month. COBRA election must occur within 60 days of the qualifying event notice; your employer's plan administrator must send a qualifying event notice within 30 days of the event, and the insurer has an additional 14 days to provide the COBRA election notice. COBRA coverage under federal law lasts 18 months for most qualifying events (job loss, reduction in hours). NC state continuation also runs up to 18 months for small-employer plans. COBRA does not reset the plan year, so if you are close to meeting a large 2026 deductible for an ongoing health situation, the math may favor COBRA for the rest of 2026. Compare the cost of completing the deductible under COBRA versus starting a new plan year under a Marketplace plan before making a final decision.
paragraphs.es: COBRA federal aplica a los empleadores de Carolina del Norte con 20 o mas empleados. La continuacion estatal de NC (a veces llamada NC mini-COBRA) aplica a los planes de salud grupales de empleadores con menos de 20 empleados bajo los Estatutos Generales de NC. Ambas le permiten continuar su cobertura anterior exacta al 102% de la prima completa (la parte del empleador mas la parte del empleado mas una tarifa administrativa del 2%). Para un plan individual tipico en NC, los costos de COBRA oscilan entre $400 y $900 por mes. Los planes familiares tipicamente cuestan $1,200 a $2,800 por mes.

en.question: How long do I have to get health insurance after losing my job in North Carolina?
en.answer: You have 60 days from the date your North Carolina job-based coverage ends to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan using the Loss of Coverage Special Enrollment Period at healthcare.gov. Your SEP starts the day after coverage ends. For example, if your coverage ends July 31, 2026, your 60-day window runs August 1 through September 29, 2026. NC Medicaid and NC Health Choice (CHIP for children) have no enrollment deadline and are available year-round if income qualifies. COBRA gives you a separate 60-day window from the date you receive the election notice to elect continuation coverage.

en.question: Does North Carolina Medicaid cover adults who just lost their jobs in 2026?
en.answer: Yes. North Carolina expanded Medicaid on December 1, 2023, extending coverage to adults ages 19 to 64 earning up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. For 2026, that is $22,025 per year for a single adult and $45,540 for a family of four. NC Medicaid is free with no monthly premium and is available year-round through healthcare.gov or the NC ePASS portal at epass.nc.gov. Many workers who earned too much for Medicaid while employed will qualify after job loss because their projected forward income drops below the 138% FPL threshold. Call NC DHHS at 1-888-245-0179 for application help.

en.question: What is the difference between COBRA and ACA Marketplace plans for North Carolina workers?
en.answer: COBRA preserves your former North Carolina employer's exact plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $2,000 or more per month for individuals. ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov offer new coverage with premium tax credits that can dramatically reduce costs. For a newly unemployed NC worker with household income between 138% and 400% FPL in 2026, Marketplace plans typically cost $10 to $300 per month after subsidies. COBRA is rarely cheaper than a subsidized Marketplace plan, but it may be worth it if you have ongoing specialty care with a provider not in any NC Marketplace network or if you have already met a significant deductible for the 2026 plan year.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove job loss for the North Carolina ACA Special Enrollment Period?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov requires documentation of the qualifying life event for a Loss of Coverage SEP. Acceptable documents include a termination of coverage letter from your North Carolina employer, a COBRA election notice showing the date your employer-sponsored coverage ends, or written confirmation from your employer's HR department of your last day of coverage. You typically have up to 30 days after enrolling in a Marketplace plan to submit this documentation online through your healthcare.gov account. Keep your termination paperwork from your employer as the primary document.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day SEP window after losing my North Carolina job?
en.answer: Missing the 60-day SEP after job-based coverage loss means you cannot enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan until the next Open Enrollment Period, which runs November 1 through December 15, 2026 for January 2027 coverage in North Carolina. However, NC Medicaid enrollment is year-round with no deadline, so if your income qualifies at any point, you can still apply through healthcare.gov or epass.nc.gov. Children remain eligible for NC Health Choice (CHIP) year-round regardless of when you apply. If you gain another qualifying life event (marriage, birth, move to a different county or state), that triggers a new 60-day SEP.

en.question: What is NC Health Choice and do my children qualify after I lose my job?
en.answer: NC Health Choice is North Carolina's CHIP (Children's Health Insurance Program). Children under age 19 qualify if your household income is between 100% and 211% of the Federal Poverty Level and they do not qualify for NC Medicaid directly. For 2026, 211% FPL is approximately $57,680 for a family of four. NC Health Choice enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Apply at healthcare.gov or through NC ePASS. The program provides comprehensive coverage including dental and vision, with premiums ranging from $0 to a small monthly amount depending on income. Even if you enroll in COBRA or a Marketplace plan yourself, your children can enroll in NC Health Choice separately.

en.question: Do North Carolina unemployment benefits count as income when applying for ACA subsidies?
en.answer: Yes. North Carolina unemployment compensation counts as Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for ACA premium tax credit calculations. When applying at healthcare.gov during your 60-day SEP, report your projected full-year 2026 income including all expected unemployment benefits. If you expect to receive unemployment for six months at $400 per week, that is approximately $10,400 to include in your projection. Accurately projecting income matters significantly in 2026 because the enhanced PTCs expired January 1, 2026, and the subsidy cliff at 400% FPL is back. Underreporting income can result in larger subsidy repayment at tax time; overreporting reduces your subsidy unnecessarily.

en.question: Can I apply for NC Medicaid and a Marketplace plan at the same time in North Carolina?
en.answer: You can apply through healthcare.gov, which screens for both NC Medicaid and Marketplace eligibility simultaneously. If healthcare.gov determines you qualify for NC Medicaid based on your projected income, it will transfer your application to NC DHHS for final eligibility determination. You cannot be enrolled in both NC Medicaid and a subsidized ACA Marketplace plan at the same time. Apply at healthcare.gov first so the system routes you correctly, or apply directly through NC ePASS at epass.nc.gov if you are fairly certain your income is below 138% FPL. If income is borderline, healthcare.gov's simultaneous screening saves time.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para obtener seguro medico despues de perder mi trabajo en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha en que termina su cobertura del trabajo en Carolina del Norte para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA usando el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por Perdida de Cobertura en healthcare.gov. Su SEP comienza el dia despues de que termina la cobertura. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura termina el 31 de julio de 2026, su ventana de 60 dias corre del 1 de agosto al 29 de septiembre de 2026. NC Medicaid y NC Health Choice (CHIP para ninos) no tienen fecha limite de inscripcion y estan disponibles todo el ano si el ingreso califica. COBRA le da una ventana separada de 60 dias desde la fecha en que recibe el aviso de eleccion para elegir la cobertura de continuacion.

es.question: NC Medicaid cubre adultos que acaban de perder su trabajo en 2026?
es.answer: Si. Carolina del Norte expandio Medicaid el 1 de diciembre de 2023, extendiendo la cobertura a adultos de 19 a 64 anos que ganan hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Para 2026, eso es $22,025 por ano para un adulto soltero y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. NC Medicaid es gratuito sin prima mensual y esta disponible todo el ano a traves de healthcare.gov o el portal NC ePASS en epass.nc.gov. Muchos trabajadores que ganaban demasiado para Medicaid mientras estaban empleados calificaran despues de perder el trabajo porque su ingreso proyectado hacia adelante cae por debajo del umbral del 138% FPL. Llame a NC DHHS al 1-888-245-0179 para ayuda con la solicitud.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre COBRA y los planes del Mercado ACA para los trabajadores de Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: COBRA preserva el plan exacto de su ex-empleador de Carolina del Norte al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $2,000 o mas por mes para individuos. Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov ofrecen nueva cobertura con creditos fiscales de prima que pueden reducir dramaticamente los costos. Para un trabajador de NC recien desempleado con ingreso del hogar entre el 138% y el 400% FPL en 2026, los planes del Mercado tipicamente cuestan $10 a $300 por mes despues de subsidios. COBRA rara vez es mas barato que un plan del Mercado subsidiado, pero puede valer la pena si tiene atencion especializada continua con un proveedor no incluido en ninguna red del Mercado de NC.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar la perdida de empleo para el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial ACA de Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov requiere documentacion del evento de vida calificador para un SEP de Perdida de Cobertura. Los documentos aceptables incluyen una carta de terminacion de cobertura de su empleador de Carolina del Norte, un aviso de eleccion de COBRA que muestre la fecha en que termina su cobertura del empleador, o confirmacion escrita del departamento de Recursos Humanos de su empleador de su ultimo dia de cobertura. Tipicamente tiene hasta 30 dias despues de inscribirse en un plan del Mercado para enviar esta documentacion en linea a traves de su cuenta de healthcare.gov.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo la ventana SEP de 60 dias despues de perder mi trabajo en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Perder el SEP de 60 dias despues de la perdida de cobertura del trabajo significa que no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta, que corre del 1 de noviembre al 15 de diciembre de 2026 para cobertura de enero de 2027 en Carolina del Norte. Sin embargo, la inscripcion de NC Medicaid es todo el ano sin fecha limite, por lo que si su ingreso califica en cualquier momento, aun puede solicitar a traves de healthcare.gov o epass.nc.gov. Los ninos siguen siendo elegibles para NC Health Choice (CHIP) todo el ano independientemente de cuando solicite.

es.question: Que es NC Health Choice y califican mis hijos despues de que pierdo mi trabajo?
es.answer: NC Health Choice es el programa CHIP (Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos) de Carolina del Norte. Los ninos menores de 19 anos califican si el ingreso de su hogar esta entre el 100% y el 211% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza y no califican directamente para NC Medicaid. Para 2026, el 211% FPL es aproximadamente $57,680 para una familia de cuatro. La inscripcion en NC Health Choice es todo el ano sin fecha limite. Solicite en healthcare.gov o a traves de NC ePASS. El programa proporciona cobertura integral que incluye dental y vision, con primas que van de $0 a una pequena cantidad mensual dependiendo del ingreso.

es.question: Los beneficios de desempleo de Carolina del Norte cuentan como ingreso al solicitar subsidios ACA?
es.answer: Si. La compensacion por desempleo de Carolina del Norte cuenta como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para los calculos del credito fiscal de prima ACA. Al solicitar en healthcare.gov durante su SEP de 60 dias, reporte su ingreso total proyectado para 2026 incluyendo todos los beneficios de desempleo esperados. Si espera recibir desempleo durante seis meses a $400 por semana, eso es aproximadamente $10,400 para incluir en su proyeccion. Proyectar con precision el ingreso importa significativamente en 2026 porque los PTCs mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026 y el abismo de subsidio al 400% FPL ha regresado.

es.question: Puedo solicitar NC Medicaid y un plan del Mercado al mismo tiempo en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Puede solicitar a traves de healthcare.gov, que verifica la elegibilidad tanto para NC Medicaid como para el Mercado simultaneamente. Si healthcare.gov determina que califica para NC Medicaid basandose en su ingreso proyectado, transferira su solicitud a NC DHHS para la determinacion final de elegibilidad. No puede estar inscrito en NC Medicaid y en un plan del Mercado ACA subsidiado al mismo tiempo. Solicite primero en healthcare.gov para que el sistema lo dirija correctamente, o solicite directamente a traves de NC ePASS en epass.nc.gov si esta bastante seguro de que su ingreso esta por debajo del 138% FPL.
